test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following lakes is NOT located in the state of Kerala?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Renuka Lake.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Renuka lake is situated in the Sirmour district of Himachal Pradesh.

 
 
• It is 672 m above sea level.
 
• Renuka Lake is located at a distance of 37 km from Nahan and 60 km from Paonta Sahib covering an area of 2.5 km.
 
• One of the popular temples of Himachal Pradesh, Renukaji is situated on the bank of this lake.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Ashtamudi lake is an estuary which lies in the Kollam district.

 
 
• This is the second-largest wetland in Kerala with a palm-shaped extensive water body and eight prominent arms, adjoining the Kollam town.
 
 
 
• Vembanad Lake is also known as Vembanad Kayal, Vembanad Kol, Punnamada Lake and Kochi Lake (in Kochi).
 
 
• This is the largest lake in Kerala and the longest lake in India.
 
• Vallam Kali (i.e Nehru Trophy Boat Race) is a Snake Boat Race held every year in the month of August in Vembanad Lake.
 
 
 
• Sasthamkotta Lake, also categorized as a wetland, is the largest freshwater lake in Kerala.
 
 
• The lake is named after the ancient Sastha temple (a pilgrimage center) located on its bank.
